source='''def transform(grid):
    """Tile the grid three times vertically in a reflected pattern and
    mirror each row into a left-right reflected pair."""
    h = len(grid)
    vertical_rows = list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1))

        row = list(grid[r])
        out.append(row[::-1] + row)
    return out
